My dear [Henrietta](/person/538)
I believe Goosedom is to be revived in the new members, not that new ones are ever so good as old.

The two first proposed are accepted, and I hope your [Lilian](/person/1008) will be, but you will hear from the [Secretary](/person/329).[^2] I am afraid I did not find her out at the Patteson’s party.[^3] We shall have to make a new arrangement as to circulation which you shall hear in the next Cackle when it is matured

yo
[signature cut out]


[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: The two new members of the [Gosling Society](/topic/104) were [Frances Mary Peard](/person/1160) and [Florence Wilford](/person/1520).
[^3]: The Pattesons were [Joan](/person/1154) and [Fanny Patteson](/person/1151), who lived at Torquay, not far from Lilian Mitchell\'s home at Kingsteignton.
